answers.core: As mentioned above, a custom implementation would be overkill to debug a single type of issue and wouldn't cover all scenarios.
answers.workaround: A custom loading system could allow for a custom implementation of this, but it would be a lot of work just to test one specific type of scenario and wouldn't cover things that aren't loaded via the load() function, such as textures assigned to sprites in the editor.

title: Add a project setting to limit disk I/O speed and make loading stutters more noticeable for debugging
